title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.33 - Two co-op attribution fixes. A teammate's Burning Pact waiting on its exhaust pick was credited as the giver of every card the other players made for themselves in the meantime; a gifted card is now credited to the play the game is actually running. With Hibernate, the block a Frost orb gives each teammate is now credited to the orb's owner instead of showing as each teammate's own block. Builds and binds against every version from v0.107.1 to v0.111.0.
